reports.title: LCI INDUSTRIES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Based on current market and economic conditions along with existing tariffs, the Company currently expects the following:
•October 2026 net sales of approximately $341 million, down 10% from prior year
•2026 North American RV wholesale shipments of 285,000 to 295,000
•2026 adjusted operating profit margin of 7.5% to 8.0%
